input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products
input.rationale: Section 6.1 binds the Company (our party) to an exclusivity covenant for the whole term. The term under Section 4.1 is one year but renews automatically on each anniversary indefinitely, and the only exit (90 days' notice) triggers a Termination Payment under Section 4.1(a), so the exclusivity effectively runs for the full, open-ended term with no performance-based release. That fails the fallback, which requires exclusivity limited to a defined product category and 12 months, ending automatically on the Vendor's failure to meet service levels or delivery dates. Because HDI bears the development and hosting burden and gives a reciprocal covenant that benefits us (untouched), we take the fallback rather than deleting the covenant: twelve months from the Effective Date, confined to the defined Deerskin Products category, lapsing automatically on any HDI service level or delivery date failure. The clause accordingly sits at the fallback once amended, not the preferred no-exclusivity position.

ops.newText: (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet; provided, that this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level or delivery date obligation.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept exclusivity running for the full, automatically renewing term with no performance-based exit, so Section 6.1 is limited to twelve months from the Effective Date for the defined Deerskin Products category and lapses automatically if HDI misses a service level or delivery date. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 is unaffected.
proposal.summary: Limit Company's exclusivity in Section 6.1 to 12 months and add automatic termination on HDI service level or delivery date failure
